1. Cooking your first real dinner
for friends, and everyone
asks for seconds.

2. Paying a bill on time
without anyone reminding you.

3. Your dad asking for your
opinion for the first time.

4. Taking a trip somewhere new
with money you earned yourself.

5. Realizing your best friend
from school is still your
best friend.

6. Fixing something yourself
instead of calling for help.

7. Learning something new just
because you were curious,
not for a grade.
